stories.title: Does buffalo get lake effect snow?
stories.snippet:
Thundersnow can be heard rumbling across the Buffalo area in western New 
York as a high-impact, lake-effect snowstorm pounded the Great Lakes region 
over the weekend.

stories.title: What is the lake effect in buffalo?
stories.snippet:
Lake effect refers to a snow band that forms off of Lake Erie and can dump 
considerable amounts of snow over a short period of time.

stories.title: Does Buffalo get a lot of snow?
stories.snippet:
Note that the city of Buffalo typically receives much less snow than the 
area 5-15 miles south of the city. For example, in the November storm of 
2022 - the Buffalo Airport received 36 inches of snow while Orchard Park - 
just 16 miles away saw 82 inches of snow.

stories.title: Did Orchard Park get snow?
stories.snippet:
Snow from the historic lake-effect snowstorm that hit Orchard Park in 
November 2022 was so deep that you could make an over 80-foot-tall snowman 
with all the snow on the Buffalo Bills' football field. 3-4 feet of snow 
fall at Buffalo's Highmark Stadium during a major lake-effect snowstorm on 
Nov. 18, 2022.
